description: This file contains partial class definitions, extension methods, and utility classes related to AWS SQS streaming integration within Orleans. It defines configuration options, stream configurators for both silo and client, and an adapter factory for SQS streams.

classes.name: SqsOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for AWS SQS connection, includes a connection string.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods to add SQS stream support to Orleans client builder.

classes.name: ClusterClientSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up SQS streams on Orleans clusters.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods to add SQS stream support to Orleans silo builder.

classes.name: SiloSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up SQS streams on Orleans silos.

classes.name: SQSAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing IQueueAdapterFactory for AWS SQS streams, responsible for creating and managing queue adapters.

classes.name: SQSStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing functions related to SQS queues, such as deleting all used queues.

methods.name: AddSqsStreams
methods.description: Extension methods to add SQS streams to client or silo configurations.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions for SQS streams.

methods.name: ConfigureSqs
methods.description: Sets up SQS options within stream configurators.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an SQSAdapterFactory instance using dependency injection.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns an SQS queue adapter instance.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a failure handler for message delivery failures on specific queues.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper used for routing streams.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedQueues
methods.description: Deletes all SQS queues used by specific provider and cluster, utility function.
